title: Dynamic size explorer for the Artisse™ Intrasaccular Device
description:
An interactive sizing chart for the Artisse™ intrasaccular device (Medtronic). The printed sizing sheet lists only a handful of fixed compression/height pairs per device; this tool turns that into a continuous relationship, so the compressed device height can be read at any aneurysm width, for all twenty Artisse sizes. Entering a measured aneurysm width and dome-to-neck height flags up to three devices whose compressed shape is likely to fit, with the resulting width compression and protrusion into the neck.

The model treats the braided nitinol mesh as a scissor mesh conserving filament length, giving H² + α²·W² = L². The two shapes published per device — nominal width and height in air, and the compressed height at the rated maximum average aneurysm width — fix the two unknowns exactly.

Important: only those two endpoints per device are manufacturer figures. Every value between and beyond them is an unvalidated estimate from a simplified model and has not been clinically verified. For education and research; not a substitute for the current Instructions for Use, your own measurements, or professional consultation. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Medtronic.
